body:
## DO NOT MERGE — evidence-gap remediation

**Disposition:** OPEN + DRAFT + `needs_followup`. This is existing canonical-game maintenance, not a new intake or promotion. Bathcat has not approved, reviewed, marked ready, promoted, or merged it.

- Base: `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd` (`origin/main`)
- Mennonite-audited old head: `51f15ea9b2857fd18db3c4acb500cc61f7963f8e` — `REVISE`
- Repaired exact head: `1f642caf0198149e35faab5b856847f24a7701b5`
- Branch: `kb/forgotten-waters-rules-components`
- Target: English 2020 first/release base game, *Forgotten Waters*, BGG 302723, Plaid Hat Games, SKU PH2900.
- Excluded unless independently proved target: *A Sea of Legends*; Kraken's Eye/DLC/add-on/promo scenarios and events; remote-play supplements; solo/low-count variants; translations; later printings/revisions; fan files; adaptations; current-app additions absent from release evidence.

## Repair of the nine audited defects

1. **Release denominator:** official 2020-06-10 “Meet the Captains” receipt closes the release app scenario count at **5**. The recovered release-era update log names four titles: Beyond the Ocean's Edge, Witch's Heart, Nature's Splendor, and Dead or Alive. The later 2024 Entry Book names those four plus Spoils of the Damned and aligns structurally with the five-count, but does not backdate exact title/data/prose equality. Immutable complete release title/build/data/entry/check/branch/audio manifests remain **UNKNOWN**.
2. **Release app evidence:** replaced the stale terminal Wayback timeout/update-log 404 account. CDX exposes captures on 2020-08-03, 2020-10-20, and 2021-01-18; the 2020-10-20 replay records v1.2 (2020-04-21, Witch's Heart audio), v1.2.1 (2020-04-22, Beyond correction), v1.2.1.1 (2020-04-23, Witch correction), v1.3 (2020-05-05, Nature's Splendor audio), v1.4.1 (2020-05-19, Dead or Alive audio), and v1.6.1 (2020-08-19). Release app-root CDX/bundle recovery remains unresolved and is not treated as absence.
3. **Ship log:** registered the official replacement `shiplog.pdf`. Two replacement PDF faces/surfaces are known; retail ship-scribe pad multiplicity, collation, and revision identity remain **UNKNOWN**. This is not a claim of two retail sheets.
4. **First-print organizer and arithmetic:** retained all 34 p.2 rows. There are **384 fixed items excluding the two pad containers**, or **386 rulebook-listed physical units counting each pad as one container**; internal sheet multiplicities remain unknown. The promotional treasure-chest organizer is explicitly dispositioned as a bundled first-print accessory outside p.2 inventory and governing game content. Its unknown internal multiplicity is not added to 386.
5. **Digital class boundary:** `scout-report.okf.md` now explicitly lists app-local **check data/check instructions**: release framework known; release IDs, counts, mappings, instruction text, and build bytes unknown. The same boundary governs this PR body.
6. **Mechanics metadata:** restored controlled slug `semi-cooperative-game` across all 12 target OKFs. Evidence is bounded to common catastrophic losses/common goal plus individual victory qualification/personal endings and Bumbling's description of selfish incentives preventing a fully cooperative feel. `weight: null` remains unchanged; no drift-prone rating prose was added.
7. **Later Entry Book:** the live support object is separately receipted as a 2025 154-page revision and expressly excluded from target authority. It is not conflated with the 2024 printer-friendly v0.1.0 148-page object.
8. **Reception receipt:** Bumbling Through Dungeons now records publication 2021-01-12 and modification 2021-06-14. Accepted witness-bounded claims and better-if labels are unchanged.
9. **Followups/prose:** structured followups now retain the unresolved immutable release bundle/data/check/audio manifest and complete FAQ/errata/support inventory beyond the recovered update log. The old update-log timeout/404 is no longer presented as the terminal archive state.

## New exact receipts

- “Meet the Captains of Forgotten Waters!”: `https://www.plaidhatgames.com/news/2020/06/10/meet-captains-forgotten-waters/`; HTTP 200 HTML; 28,743 bytes; SHA-256 `754d8dd68cee421bf451cebf9689d276477e1d9b007e8abe8cde973345e04eae`; governing fact: “All five scenarios in the Forgotten Waters app now include full narration.”
- Retired official update-log locator: `https://www.plaidhatgames.com/forgotten-waters-app-latest-updates/`.
- CDX authority: `https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=www.plaidhatgames.com%2Fforgotten-waters-app-latest-updates%2F&output=json&filter=statuscode%3A200`; successful captures at 2020-08-03, 2020-10-20, 2021-01-18.
- 2020-10-20 Wayback replay: `https://web.archive.org/web/20201020203128id_/https://www.plaidhatgames.com/forgotten-waters-app-latest-updates/`; 12,233 bytes; SHA-256 `b84d5202ace004b9f2ee484ddc6cf78a79c948dfac86e9d51083600101b4ad12`.
- Replacement ship log: `https://media.plaidhatgames.com/filer_public/2a/47/2a4788ef-b238-416e-be42-bcf2843fd3d0/shiplog.pdf`; HTTP 200 PDF; 326,362 bytes; 2 pages at 648×468 pt; SHA-256 `0b1e7fc0d70c63689077a52bb1bbdcbcf46b09204d0a04121f8ad7004bce6244`; created 2019-11-04, modified 2020-03-23.
- Current support Entry Book revision: `https://media.plaidhatgames.com/filer_public/66/59/6659eeec-2b88-4e4a-a54d-ce9c77567782/forgotten_waters_entry_book.pdf`; HTTP 200 PDF; 34,031,011 bytes; 154 letter pages; SHA-256 `7ce652179b4a58dc2d6addd665e647f887781c203a6c7dc1b2714bd10a66fe32`; created 2025-09-19. Later comparison only.
- Preserved 2024 printer-friendly Entry Book: 9,695,283 bytes; 148 letter pages; v0.1.0; SHA-256 `7711e3b336cf2047c0e76111027d1206250398c376f00b306554916d9cede7e2`; created 2024-02-14.

## App boundary

The app remains governing content rather than an adaptation. Release functional behavior comes from the 2020 rules/FAQ; release scenario count is known as five; recovered update history supplies dated versions and four titles. Immutable release bundle bytes and complete release data/entry/check/branch/audio manifests remain unknown.

Current-only v1.12.0 evidence remains separately bounded: exact current main JS 25,763,159 bytes / SHA-256 `4ba98cb8c67d8bd0bafd482ed3963a6b6a9052c0172a5243486040c2634ed884`; six English scenario roots (five base plus later Kraken's Eye); 69 locale/scenario rows across 13 locales; English scenario + `generic2` + `generic` roots; and 7,941 literal audio paths (7,850 MP3 + 91 WAV). These code-literal counts are not release facts.

## Files and artifact preservation

Repair commit changed 14 paths: the 12 Forgotten Waters OKFs, generated `KnowledgeBase/BoardGames/INDEX.okf.md`, and `TELEMETRY.md`. No WebP or other visual byte changed. Existing visual manifest paths, hashes, recipe, and contact sheet remain intact; only the required mechanics firewall changed in `visuals/packet.okf.md`.

All 12 target records remain `status: needs_followup`. No percentage or composite coverage claim is made. Physical, digital, replacement-source, and later-comparison authority remain separated.

## Gates and exact-head CI

Passed locally in the prescribed final writer sequence:

- `node scripts/generate-index.mjs`
- `node scripts/validate-okf.mjs` — 2,619 files clean + INDEX fresh
- `node --test scripts/intake-lib.test.mjs scripts/validate-intake-package.test.mjs scripts/fail-closed.test.mjs scripts/validate-okf-provenance.test.mjs` — 32 tests, 31 pass, 1 intentional skip, 0 fail
- committed-head `node scripts/validate-intake.mjs --base origin/main` — clean
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — clean

Exact-head CI: Actions run `30629106576`, job `91151106063`, `validate` **SUCCESS** on `1f642caf0198149e35faab5b856847f24a7701b5`: https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30629106576/job/91151106063

## Residual help required

- confirmed PH2900 first-print physical inspection/lot markers and nonreplacement face/side/identity evidence, plus organizer physical particulars;
- immutable release app bundle/data/check/audio manifest and comparison to current;
- authoritative complete FAQ/errata/support inventory beyond the recovered update log;
- licensed narrative/audio denominator without unlawful mirroring.

Bathcat-Authored: true

Receiver: Judge, then one wholly fresh Mennonite audit context bound to exact head `1f642caf0198149e35faab5b856847f24a7701b5`. T remains final authority. This repair is not an approval or merge request.

**DO NOT MERGE.**
